title: Nearest Graph Laplacians with Prescribed Connected Components: A Convex Framework for Network Reconstruction
summary: We study the problem of constructing the nearest graph Laplacian matrix to a given Laplacian while enforcing a prescribed connected-component structure. Let the vertex set be partitioned into nonempty disjoint blocks $C_1,\ldots,C_k$, and let $U=[u_1,\ldots,u_k]$ be the matrix of the corresponding block-indicator vectors. The constraint $MU=0$ ensures that these prescribed indicators lie in the nullspace of the optimized Laplacian $M^\star$, and hence the associated graph has at least $k$ connected components.
